 What to Stream 5 Upcoming South Indian OTT Releases (Nov 9-15): Jailer 2, Bandra, The Third Murder And More 
 We bring you 5 upcoming South Indian OTT releases to watch around November 9-15, 2026, including Rajinikanth's Jailer 2, Dileep and Tamannaah Bhatia's Bandra, The Third Murder, Ranabaali and Crazy Kalyanam. Check their streaming platforms, release dates, cast details and storylines across Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam cinema.  Next week, your remote is going to be visiting a lot of apps. Amazon Prime Video, ZEE5, ManoramaMAX, Netflix and Aha each have a South Indian title lined up between November 9 and 15, and together they cover Tamil, Malayalam and Telugu cinema. So, if you would like to plan the week before the notifications start, here are some ideas you can pick. The upcoming South Indian OTT releases next week are Jailer 2, Bandra, The Third Murder, Ranabaali and Crazy Kalyanam. Jailer 2 arrives on November 12, and Bandra and The Third Murder follow on November 13. Ranabaali’s November 13 date comes from a now-deleted Netflix post, and Crazy Kalyanam is yet to get an exact date on Aha. Check out the films, their streaming platforms, cast details and storylines below.
 Upcoming South Indian OTT Releases (Nov 9-15)
 Jailer 2 OTT Release, Amazon Prime Video (November 12)
 Rajinikanth returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian in Nelson Dilipkumar’s sequel, which sees the retired jailer pulled into a fresh fight with a criminal syndicate threatening his family. Mohanlal, Vijay Sethupathi, Shivarajkumar, SJ Suryah, Hrithik Roshan, Vidya Balan and Mithun Chakraborty are in the cast. It streams in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada.
 Bandra OTT Release, ZEE5 (November 13)
 Dileep and Tamannaah Bhatia’s 2023 Malayalam romantic gangster drama finally makes its digital debut after more than three years. Directed by Arun Gopy, it moves between 1990s Hindi film glamour and the underworld, with Dileep as businessman Alexander Aala Dominic and Tamannaah as actress Tara Janaki. Dino Morea, Mamta Mohandas, R Sarathkumar and Siddique co-star.
 You may also like New OTT Releases This Diwali Weekend (Nov 6-8, 2026): Yaga, Dilwali Diwali, I'm Game And More The Third Murder OTT Release, ManoramaMAX (November 13)
 Saiju Kurup plays DYSP Christy in Sunil Ibrahim’s Malayalam thriller, which follows a police investigation into a series of connected killings. With few leads, Christy turns to a retired officer for help. Indrans, Vinay Forrt, Ananya and Liona also star. International viewers can watch it on Simply South.
 Ranabaali OTT Release, Netflix 
 Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna reunite for Rahul Sankrityan's Telugu period action drama, set during British rule and inspired by events in Rayalaseema during the Great Madras Famine of the 1870s. Vijay plays a rebellious warrior, while Rashmika portrays his wife, Jayamma. Arnold Vosloo appears as the antagonist. Although November 13 has been reported as its Netflix premiere date, an official confirmation from the streaming platform is still awaited.
 Crazy Kalyanam OTT Release, Aha
 Anupama Parameswaran and Tharun Bhascker lead Badrappa Gajula’s Telugu family comedy, set in Medak, Telangana. Naresh plays a father set on finding a financially secure match for his younger daughter Keerthi (Anupama), who has her own career plans. Aha lists it in its November lineup, but the exact date is yet to be announced.
